## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, the resulting behavior, and any compatibility implications.

## Architecture and provenance

Link the design invariant, architecture decision, public contract, and implementation. Explain any intentional contract change before describing its implementation.

## Category impact

Use [PR Review Standard v1.1.0](https://github.com/paragon-ux/Patch-DIFF/blob/4563a49ed4c46e8687b6fd5079649d5f0304918c/docs/PR_REVIEW_STANDARD.md). Map every changed file in the review report.

| Category | Impacted files / reason not applicable |
| --- | --- |
| Architecture and contracts | |
| Documentation and change records | |
| Skills and agent instructions | |
| MCP schemas and public API | |
| Core runtime, parsing, and validation | |
| Services, orchestration, and audit semantics | |
| Database, migrations, replay, and concurrency | |
| Scripts, evaluation, and developer tooling | |
| Tests and CI | |
| Dependencies, packaging, and configuration | |

## Validation evidence

List commands, results, environment, database, and tested SHA. Distinguish local execution, inspected CI, and checks not run.

## Review record

Link the category-separated report under docs/reviews/. Every category needs its own coverage, separate P1/P2/P3 finding lists (explicitly empty or unassessed where applicable), verification gaps, and verdict. Include stable finding IDs and closure evidence. The author impact table is not a completed independent review.
